projects.name: ant-design
projects.notes: Candidate project. Ant Design, the main Jest suite as the repo runs it (npm test: jest --config .jest.js --no-cache; renamed to .jest.ts upstream on 2026-10-28 (#59704), which the harness picks up when .jest.js is missing), Jest 30.5.2 with jest-environment-jsdom 30.5.2 (the root also depends on jsdom ^30.1.1), testEnvironment jsdom, setupFiles tests/setup.ts and jest-canvas-mock, the @ant-design/tools babel preprocessor. 583 test files (components/**/__tests__, including the demo, demo-extend and demo-semantic snapshot suites), 7899 tests (102 skipped). --no-cache as in the repo scripts: with a warm Jest cache from another checkout, every suite failed with genStyleUtils is not a function. The build step is the repo pretest (npm run version: writes components/version/version.ts). Excluded as the repo config does: node, dekko and image tests (.jest.node.js, .jest.image.js with Puppeteer). The partial Vitest gate (vitest.config.ts, 169 files) is not used. No lockfile (.npmrc package-lock=false, legacy-peer-deps=true): npm install resolves current versions, so installs are not exactly reproducible; PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1 skips the Chrome download (Puppeteer is only for the image tests). The repo CI uses Node 24 and utoo; install and tests run on Node 22.23.3. Local check (M-series laptop under other load, 2 workers): jsdom 7745/7899 passed in 847 s, warpdom 7730 in 164 s, 15 tests / 12 files differ; the 52 jsdom failures are date/calendar snapshot and demo tests that fail on jsdom too.

projects.name: chakra-ui
projects.notes: Candidate project. One root Vitest run (vite.config.ts: environment jsdom, setupFiles vitest.setup.ts, include **/*test.{ts,tsx}), as the repo's CI runs pnpm test: packages/react plus the cli and codemod tests (their own vitest.config.ts files use the node environment, but the root run includes them on jsdom). Vitest 4.1.8, jsdom 26.1.0. pnpm 11.10.0 (pnpm-lock.yaml), no build step (aliases point at sources). Local check (M-series laptop, 2 workers): 89 files, 1065/1065 passed on jsdom in 29 s and on warpdom in 23 s.

projects.name: storybook
projects.kind: UI development tool (manager UI, preview runtime, renderers, addons)
projects.notes: Candidate project. Only Storybook's DOM unit tests: Vitest 5.0.3, with environment node by default (code/vitest.shared.ts) and happy-dom 17.6.3 where a DOM is used, so the harness switches them (jsdom is not a dependency and is linked from dom-api-tracer). Package .: the root config (string project globs) restricted to the 14 projects that hold the 93 test files pinned with a @vitest-environment happy-dom (one: jsdom) comment, and to those files by name; the harness switches the pinned comments. Package code/renderers/svelte: the Svelte renderer's own config sets environment happy-dom for all 39 of its files, so it runs separately (the root config's string projects are not switched). Excluded: about 870 node-environment test files, agent-eval, and the storybook-ui project (Vitest browser mode, Playwright). --typecheck.enabled=false: core and angular enable type tests. The build step is the repo CI's compile task (tests import dist output, e.g. @storybook/svelte/dist). yarn 4.18.0 (yarn.lock, nodeLinker node-modules), .nvmrc Node 22.22.3; runs on Node 22.23.3. The suite is written for happy-dom, so some files fail on jsdom. Local check (M-series laptop, 2 workers): root 1187 tests (6 skipped), jsdom 1166 passed in 41 s, warpdom 1173 in 30 s; svelte 207/207 on jsdom (transform.test.ts fails to load: TextEncoder Uint8Array realm invariant) in 13 s, 209/209 on warpdom in 10 s; 9 tests / 2 files differ in all.

projects.name: mantine
projects.kind: component library (components, hooks, forms, dates, charts)
projects.notes: Candidate project. Mantine 9.7.3, the Jest suite as the repo CI runs it (the last step of npm test, which first runs format, syncpack, typecheck, lint and docs:links; only Jest is measured): jest with the root jest.config.ts, Jest 30.5.2 with jest-environment-jsdom 30.5.2 (jsdom 26.1.0), the esbuild-jest 0.5.0 transform, setupFilesAfterEnv jsdom.mocks.ts (jest-dom, matchMedia/ResizeObserver/IntersectionObserver stubs, any console.error or console.warn fails the test) and jest.react.ts, moduleNameMapper to the packages sources, testTimeout 30 s, workerIdleMemoryLimit 512MB, React 19.3.0, @testing-library/react 16.3.3. 749 test files (packages/@mantine/* with core 353, schedule 101, form 74, dates 70, hooks 68, charts 37; plus @docs/styles-api and scripts), 18030 tests (16 skipped). Nothing excluded but the .claude directory, as the config does. TZ=UTC (package env) as on the GitHub runner: the @mantine/schedule tests assume UTC; in America/Toronto 62 tests in 6 files failed and four MonthView/YearView files ran 5 to 11 minutes each. No build step: the tests import sources, not build output (the CI setup and build all steps are for the docs and the ESM entry check; a run without them passes everything). yarn 4.18.0 (yarn.lock, nodeLinker node-modules), the default yarn install --immutable. The repo CI uses Node 26.3.0 (.nvmrc; engines >=22); runs on Node 22.23.3. Nothing patched. Local check (M-series laptop, 2 workers): jsdom 18014/18030 passed, 0 failed, in 102 s; warpdom 0.1.6 17974 passed in 82 s, 40 tests / 1 file differ: schedule MoreEvents.test.tsx (popoverProps opened: true) gets an act() warning from a floating-ui position update (@floating-ui/react-dom flushSync setState after the test), which jsdom.mocks.ts turns into a failure of the following test, 40 in all; the same on a second run of that file alone, which passes on jsdom.

projects.name: n8n
projects.notes: Candidate project, the first application screened for adoption (warpdom PLAN.md, adoption plan A6). n8n's editor (packages/frontend/editor-ui, the Vue 3 single-page app) in a pnpm workspace: Vitest 5.0.1, jsdom 23.0.1, Vite 8, Vue 3.5, @testing-library/vue 8. vitest.config.mts merges vite.config.mts with @n8n/vitest-config/frontend (environment jsdom, globals, restoreMocks, silent, passWithNoTests, setupFiles src/__tests__/setup.ts, test.alias to element-plus's single-file bundle and a stub for node icon SVGs, server.deps.inline vitest-mock-extended and @testing-library/jest-dom); no workspace projects, no environmentMatchGlobs, default pool and isolation; one file (Canvas.test.ts) pins @vitest-environment jsdom, which the harness switches. The setup file imports @n8n/vitest-config/setup/frontend, which stubs globals on every run: TZ=UTC, an in-memory localStorage/sessionStorage only where the global is missing (Node >= 26), PointerEvent replaced by a MouseEvent subclass, hasPointerCapture/setPointerCapture, ResizeObserver if missing, IntersectionObserver, matchMedia (editor-ui overrides it to match every query), Worker, SharedWorker, DataTransfer, SpeechSynthesis, HTMLCanvasElement getContext, scrollIntoView/scrollTo, Range getBoundingClientRect/getClientRects, requestAnimationFrame on globalThis via setTimeout, XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send failing synchronously, and an unhandledRejection filter for SCSS teardown errors; editor-ui adds fake-indexeddb, a reka-ui Popover mock, and HTMLDialogElement show/showModal/close only where missing. 1501 test files (about 21000 test cases by a static count), about 90% of the frontend unit-test time: n8n's CI runs every frontend package's Vitest with --shard=k/4 in 4 jobs on Node 24.22.1 and 26.12.1 (blacksmith 4 vCPU; run 41615645500 at the pin, all green: 8 jobs of 8 to 10 minutes, editor-ui's part of shard 2/4 375 files in 365 s). Measured: shard 1/4 (--shard=1/4, about 375 files), the part of the suite one of n8n's own CI jobs runs; the whole suite with 2 workers on a 4 vCPU GitHub runner would take about 40 to 60 minutes per run, over the timing scripts' 45-minute limit per package run, and the harness keys results by package directory, so the four shards cannot be listed as four packages yet. Not measured: the other frontend packages (design-system 148 files, chat, stores, composables, the feature modules' frontends; the next candidates) and the backend (node environment). pnpm 12.4.2 (packageManager; pnpm-lock.yaml; pmOnFail warn), engines node >=24. Install with --ignore-scripts: the allowed dependency builds are backend native modules (isolated-vm 7.0.2 has prebuilt binaries for Node 24 and 26 only and would compile from source on Node 22; @confluentinc/kafka-javascript, sqlite3, @vscode/ripgrep), editor-ui's Vite config stubs isolated-vm, and no workspace package has an install script; the root preinstall (refuses npm) and prepare (lefthook, skipped under CI) are not needed. The build step builds the workspace packages editor-ui depends on (turbo build --filter n8n-editor-ui^..., 44 packages: tsc, tsdown and the design-system and chat Vite builds), as turbo's test task does (dependsOn ^build); the tests import their dist (@n8n/vitest-config's included). NODE_OPTIONS --max-old-space-size=7168 as in n8n's unit-test workflow. Runs on Node 22.23.3 (the corpus Node), below the engines field (pnpm warns; engineStrict is not set). Not run locally: the install was not run here, so install, build and the first results come from the timing workflow.
projects.build: TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='n8n-editor-ui^...'

projects.name: grafana
projects.notes: Candidate project, the second application screened for adoption (warpdom PLAN.md, adoption plan A6). Grafana's frontend (the React single-page app in public/app plus the workspace packages in packages/*), one root Jest run as the repo CI runs it (pnpm run test:ci: jest --ci --shard=k/8 with jest.config.js). Jest 29.7.0 with jest-environment-jsdom 29.7.0 (jsdom 20.0.2), the ts-jest 29.4.10 transform (tsconfig isolatedModules, so no type check), React 19.2, @testing-library/react 16.3. jest.config.js: testEnvironment jsdom, testEnvironmentOptions customExportConditions ['@grafana-app/source', 'browser'] (the workspace packages' exports point that condition at their src, so no build step; warpdom's Jest environment reads customExportConditions as jest-environment-jsdom does), roots public/app, public/swagger, public/test, packages and scripts/tests, a custom resolver (public/test/jest-resolver.js: drops browser exports for msw, @mswjs/interceptors and react-colorful), moduleDirectories public and node_modules, moduleNameMapper mocks (images, CSS, react-inlinesvg, near-membrane-dom, @grafana/assistant), transformIgnorePatterns that transform about 40 ESM packages (d3, ol, monaco-editor, ...), testTimeout 30 s, workerIdleMemoryLimit 1GB, and process.env.TZ = 'Pacific/Easter' set when the config loads. Ignored as the config does: the decoupled azuremonitor, testdata and graphite datasources (their own test jobs). Setup on every file: setupFiles jest-canvas-mock and public/test/jest-setup.ts (jQuery made global and the vendored flot plugins loaded, blob-polyfill, mutationobserver-shim, a worker mock, grafanaBootData, matchMedia always false, an IntersectionObserver mock that reports every element in view, document.fonts, TextEncoder/TextDecoder from util, TransformStream and MessageChannel from Node, BroadcastChannel stub, Element scrollTo and HTMLElement scrollIntoView stubs, URL.canParse where missing (jsdom 20), a ResizeObserver mock reporting 500x500, unhandled rejections thrown); setupFilesAfterEnv public/test/setupTests.ts (core-js structuredClone, whatwg-fetch, jest-dom, Grafana's matchers, i18next, jest.mock of dashboard and folder API version resolvers, the change-detection worker and plugin extension hooks, asyncUtilTimeout 2 s, performance.mark/measure stubs where missing, Range getClientRects/getBoundingClientRect stubs where missing). With CI set (the harness sets CI=1), jest-fail-on-console fails any test that logs to the console at any level (log, debug, info, warn, error), as in Grafana's CI. One file pins @jest-environment jsdom (packages/grafana-test-utils/src/canvas/path2d.test.ts, in shard 4), which the harness switches. 2836 test files at the pin (open-source part; 1445 .tsx), about 38000 tests: Grafana's CI runs them with --shard=k/8 in 8 jobs, 4 workers each, on Node 26.13.0 (.nvmrc) on its own ubuntu-x64-large runners (fork PR run 41626451766: 355 or 354 files and 4300 to 5400 tests per shard, Jest time 175 to 254 s per shard; on pushes to main an enterprise job adds the closed-source extensions, about 3020 files). Measured: shard 1/8 (--shard=1/8, 355 files, the files Grafana's CI job 1/8 runs for a fork PR at the pin: Jest shards by the SHA-1 of each file's path relative to rootDir; 226 in public/app/features, 39 in packages/grafana-ui, 32 in public/app/plugins, 22 in public/app/core; at the pin, push run 41635606491 with the enterprise files, a different split: shard 1/8 378 files, 4575 tests, 226 s). The whole suite with 2 workers on a 4 vCPU GitHub runner would take far over the timing scripts' 45-minute limit per package run, and 3 rounds x 3 configurations plus warm-ups of one shard fit the 355-minute job. Not measured: the other seven shards, the enterprise extensions, the decoupled plugins (nx test:ci, own configs) and the Vitest rspack and release tests. Shards 3, 5 and 6 hold the dashboard migration tests that read golden files generated by Go in Grafana's CI (make generate-golden-files in apps/dashboard; DashboardMigratorToBackend.devDashboards.test.ts fails without them); shard 1 has none. pnpm 12.15.0 (packageManager; pnpm-lock.yaml; allowBuilds disables every dependency build script; no workspace package or the root has an install script), engines node >= 22 < 27: the default pnpm install --frozen-lockfile as in Grafana's CI, no build step (the unit-test job only installs). Runs on Node 22.23.3 (the corpus Node), inside the engines range. Pinned at the newest main commit whose checks all passed (Frontend tests run 41635606491: the 8 unit-test shards, packages, decoupled plugin and rspack jobs). Not run locally: install and the first results come from the timing workflow.
